# A zero-argument function named where its result is expected is called. It was
# only called when the return type already matched the prop, so an int-returning
# computed on a string prop was wrapped in a func-to-string conversion and html
# emitted an empty span.

sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html --out=out app.sngl
grep 'doubled\(' out/index.html

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl://std"

component main {
    var count = 2
    func doubled() => count * 2
    text(value=doubled)
}
